description: Image Description: The image shows an electric toothbrush standing upright in a charging base. The toothbrush has a white body with a blue button and a digital display. The brand name "Oral-B" and "Braun" are visible on the toothbrush. The charging base is silver and blue, with the "Oral-B" logo on it. In the background, there is a transparent container holding additional toothbrush heads. The scene appears to be set on a wooden surface, possibly a bathroom counter.
